_doc: Written by scene/export_game.py. Godot axes: godot (x, y, z) = blender (x, z, -y). Pixels: the 2560 x 1440 game frame, row 0 at the top.

camera._doc: Orthographic game camera. basis columns are the camera's local +X (right), +Y (up), +Z (back; it looks along -Z), already in Godot axes. size is the frame width in meters (Godot keep_aspect = KEEP_WIDTH). The image-centre shift is baked into origin.

depth._doc: depth.f32: float32 little-endian, width*height, row 0 = top. Metres along the camera axis from the camera origin (orthographic). Sky pixels hold sky_m.

layers.color_space: linear Rec.709, scene-referred, exposure already applied

post._doc: kuwahara: painterly brush size in px. bloom: glare strength above threshold. grade: lift/gamma/gain RGB. vignette: edge darkening 0..1.

masks._doc: normal: camera-space unit normal as rgb = n * 0.5 + 0.5 (x right, y up, z toward the camera). ids: 8-bit, 0 = nothing, k = hotspot k (1-based, hotspots.json order)

views._doc: Zoom views. wide: zoom 0.5, its own camera block (same direction and image centre, twice the coverage). tiles: zoom 2 around each hotspot; rect is in main-frame px [x0, y0, w, h], the tile images are rect * scale px. A tile lists only the light groups that reach it; the others are zero there (their faint rest is in its base). Images, depth, ids and masks follow the main frame's formats.

camera._doc: Orthographic game camera. basis columns are the camera's local +X (right), +Y (up), +Z (back; it looks along -Z), already in Godot axes. size is the frame width in meters (Godot keep_aspect = KEEP_WIDTH). The image-centre shift is baked into origin.

crows._doc: crow.glb faces Godot +Z (Blender -Y) at yaw 0, feet at the origin. Perch yaw is degrees about Godot +Y (the same angle as Blender rot_z). Nodes body, head, tail, wing_l, wing_r; the pivots sit at the neck, the tail base and the shoulders.

walk._doc: walk.glb: walkable surfaces only, obstacle footprints cut out, no agent radius. Stairs are treads (risers up to 0.25 m): bake with agent_max_climb >= 0.26. links join stair foot and top. Each face's material names the surface underfoot: cobble, mud, straw, stone_stair, stone_walk, wood. Puddles are not a face type: use the puddle mask under the figure. portals: walking into a hides the figure for `seconds`, then it steps out at b (and the reverse); label names a, label_b names b.

ambient._doc: blue-hour sky fill for real-time objects

layers.raw_groups_vs_noisy_combined_identity: Cycles combined is denoised; raw groups are not
